plugins.name: silent-decisions
plugins.description: Stops coding agents from making important decisions silently: asks before choices that hurt the app later, raises past decisions that no longer fit, and records approved ones in decisions.md.

plugins.name: fix-without-overfitting
plugins.description: Fix a pipeline from its real failures without teaching it the test set: failure cases, a frozen held-out set, checking the fix for names and ids copied from the failures, and proof on unseen data.

plugins.name: priced-in
plugins.description: Find out whether a prediction market knew before the news: pin the news moment, search for earlier leaks on the web and X, pull Polymarket prices and trades, explain each move, and give a verdict.

plugins.name: reply-review
plugins.description: Review an agent's proposal by quoting it: numbered proposal blocks, point-by-point answers to every quoted line, a tally of what is open, and nothing applied until you approve.
